title: Police Disable Suspect's Vehicle During Chase
description:
Police Shut Off Suspect's Vehicle During Chase

On May 11, 2021, a business in Lake Delton, WI reported a work vehicle had been stolen from their parking lot. Employees were able to track down the vehicle using GPS and contacted On-star to have the vehicle shut down. Moments later, On-star successfully brought the vehicle to a halt and the suspect was apprehended.
